Scenario fixture: rgaa-language-change-review (RGAA 8.7.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form lgc_case_NN. The page declares lang="en"; passages of 8 words or more clearly in another language, with no lang on them or a parent, are asked about.

01 — CANTTELL: a French paragraph with no lang

Les inscriptions sont gratuites pour les habitants de la commune et pour les personnes qui y travaillent.

02 — CANTTELL: a German list item with no lang
  • Die Anmeldung ist für alle Einwohner der Stadt kostenlos und kann jederzeit gekündigt werden.
03 — NOT APPLICABLE: a French paragraph that carries lang

Les inscriptions sont gratuites pour les habitants de la commune et pour les personnes qui y travaillent.

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: a short foreign quote and a name

The mayor opened the new Médiathèque Jean-Pierre Dupont with a short « bienvenue à tous » for the visitors.

05 — NOT APPLICABLE: an English paragraph

The library is open from Tuesday to Saturday, and it is open in the morning only during the school holidays. You can borrow up to ten items for three weeks and renew them once from your account. Registration is free for the people who live or work in the town, and a proof of address will be asked for on your first visit. Children under fourteen have to come with an adult when they register.
